content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial concerns missing required authorization, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Correcting the invalid CPT/diagnosis pairing alone would not resolve that denial, and the deductible does not establish patient liability for an authorization-related denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table and can use the clinic documentation to seek reconsideration.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
